response.justification: Strong, broad senior/staff-level engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, embedded and infrastructure, including genuine high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic/dunnhumby (millions of HTTP requests/second, async I/O, fibers, caching) and current hands-on work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling — which maps directly to the AI-native environment expectation. Craftsmanship practices (TDD, pairing, trunk-based development, CI/CD) and founder/tech-lead experience suggest ownership and agile maturity. The main gaps are the absence of Python anywhere in the skills or project history despite it being a must-have, and limited explicit evidence of technical-strategy ownership, cross-functional stakeholder management, or formal on-call/incident-response responsibility at scale. Worth a screen to probe Python depth and scope of influence.
strengths: Proven high-throughput distributed systems experience (millions of req/sec)
Current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling work
Deep craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling, strong TypeScript/Node
concerns: No evidence of Python, a stated must-have
Thin evidence of technical strategy and stakeholder management at scale
Distributed-systems depth is dated (2018–2020) and D-language specific
